I verified the section/page anchors against the publisher-hosted contents: the design's "Durrett pp. 285–311" locator is stale; §5.5+ belongs to PT-17.

**Observations recorded (no action needed for this decision):** Durrett Thm 5.3.8 (coercive supermartingale recurrence criterion) is the one exclusion a reader might expect given the page's Lyapunov hitting bound — design-level omission, no consumer needs it; intended method overlaps with published gambler's ruin (optional stopping vs harmonicity) and kernel-form CK; Roch Thm 24.7's recorded nonexit-equality defect is noted for Step 3b/5; Varadhan §4.6 / Le Gall §§13.4–13.7 are named in the design but unharvested — no item depends on them, uncertainty stated honestly in the report.
